record.name: Google Ads
record.one_liner: Create and manage ads that reach users looking for your products or services on Google Search, Display, YouTube and more.
record.access_note: Developers obtain credentials via self-serve sign-up along with a developer token that requires access level reviews.
record.api_note: The Google Ads API provides comprehensive programmatic access to campaigns, reporting, budgets, and ad management.
record.blocker_note: Production usage requires moving beyond test account access through Google's API access review process.

evidence.quote: The Google Ads API uses OAuth 2.0 for authorizing API requests.
Google Ads API developer tokens have an access level determining production account access
Build an application to interact directly with the Google Ads platform or write programmatic scripts.
The Google Ads MCP server provides a standardized bridge to the Google Ads API

flags_before.detail: access is backed only by non-vendor pages
